_comment_purpose: Quality gate catalog. A gate is a named check or reviewer goal that an agent identity must satisfy. Reviewer-swarm goals reference this catalog via id; reviewer identities compose the same gates via `qualityGates`. Three gate kinds are supported: `checks` (CI-style command), `review-goal` (specialized reviewer focus), and `command` (manual command).

gates.description: Run the project's TypeScript type check (tsc --noEmit or equivalent) before marking work complete.
Run `git diff --check` on the working tree to catch whitespace/conflict-marker errors.

Behavior reviewer — validate that changed-code acceptance behavior is satisfied. For TUI / runtime behavior, require runnable behavior test, runtime gate, or observed tool output; reject source-string / static-only / read-the-source / skipped-running evidence.
Evidence/test-adequacy reviewer — validate that validation evidence is concrete and complete for each acceptance criterion. Reject prompt-only / instructions-only mitigations for runtime behavior.
Implementation reviewer — validate the implementation diff matches the Brain-authored contract/block plan, with correct boundaries, imports, and behavior.
Maintainability/architecture reviewer — flag regressions in module ownership, coupling, runtime integration shape, and patterns introduced by implementation changes.
Regression reviewer — verify the change does not regress existing behavior; require runnable regression evidence for runtime-behavior criteria.

Docs/config reviewer (scoped) — validate README, docs/, examples/, and workflow config (workflow.json / workflow.quality-gates.json / settings.json) stay consistent with implementation. Active only when docs/config files are in the plan scope.
